neighbours.label: the head word right after a vivid heat/motion/predator first word in a fixed name or compound (Burning Man, Rushmore, Shark Club, spin structure, SparkNotes, action park); the same head word after a neutral modifier stays quiet
fire: Her brother drove a van all the way to Burning Man with six friends.
A postcard of Mount Rushmore hung above the motel desk.
After the game the whole team walked over to Shark Club for wings.
The lecture explained when a spin structure exists on a curved surface.
He skimmed the SparkNotes on the bus before the quiz.
Our cousins spent Saturday at an action park outside the city.
Moses stopped when he noticed the burning bush beside the path.
The mechanic replaced a fouled spark plug in the old mower.
quiet: Her brother drove a van all the way to Portland with six friends.
A postcard of Mount Everest hung above the motel desk.
After the game the whole team walked over to the tennis club for wings.
The lecture explained when a smooth structure exists on a curved surface.
He skimmed the lecture notes on the bus before the quiz.
Our cousins spent Saturday at a quiet park outside the city.
Moses stopped when he noticed the old man beside the path.
The mechanic replaced a worn drain plug in the old mower.

notes: Card: no single token (Man, structure, Club, Notes, park, more). Probes: 'Burning Man' 0.95-0.99, lower-case 'burning man' 0.85, 'Rushmore' 0.91-0.93, 'Shark Club' 0.85, 'spin structure' 0.98; 'Comedy Club' 0.10, 'Yellowstone Park' 0.15, 'Viper Room' 0.03, 'Iron Man' 0.29, 'Grand Canyon' 0.00. The generalisation to new vivid first words is a guess; the - pole is the second half of adjective compounds (trigger-happy, power-hungry, pressure-sensitive).
